{{Otheruses|Lily}}
A '''lily''' was a type of [[Flower/Legends|flower]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Valon Rizz]] kept delicate white lilies on his desk as part of a [[Water/Legends|water]] garden. One type of lily was the [[Alderaanian flame-lily]].<ref name="Ringers">{{JournalCite|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
